answer: Because of that, an attacker who spins up 116 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 66 times the capital for one share. Each collapsed cluster gets one thread weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The jade report makes public the merge explicitly at each voyage. A farm of 4341 identities would post 3881 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
